messages:
Mira (partnerships): Quick sync — we need final assets + SKU mapping for the three-cloud listing. AWS/GCP/Azure all want slightly different image/brand sizes and one-off offer IDs. Can the product and eng teams confirm which packaging variants we ship?
Alex (partnerships): +1. Also need sandbox publisher credentials for staging so partners can validate billing flows. Can ops hand over a temporary offer ID? @Leo any constraints on AMI/VM image naming? :sweat_smile:
Sam (legal): FYI we need the final EULA excerpt and a line about telemetry (opt-in/opt-out) before any public listing. If we change trial length we might need to update the trial terms in the contract addendum. Please drop the exact wording here.
Jordan (product): Packaging plan: offer tiers are "Starter (trial)" -> trial 14d, "Scale" -> 30d eval, "Enterprise" -> no trial. Variant matrix: public hosted, dedicated-reserved, and private (BYO infra). For marketplace we expose Starter + Scale. Enterprise via private quote only.
Leo (eng): For images: AWS requires an AMI manifest and EULA id field. Azure needs a VM image + OfferID in the publisher portal. GCP expects a marketplace solution with a listing manifest and an oauth callback for trial provisioning. I can generate the AMI metadata and a sample Terraform snippet.
Leo (eng): Sample AMI manifest snippet (for staging):
```
ami_name = "redwood-inference-dedicated-2024-rt"
version = "2024.12.01"
ami_id = "ami-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890"
licenses = ["redwood-eula-v1"]
```
Alex (partnerships): Great. Mira, can you confirm hero image sizes? AWS wants 1024x512, Azure suggests 1200x600, GCP prefers 900x500. We'll produce 3 variants. Also we need one short marketing blurb (280 chars) and one tech blurb for the listing page.
Mira (partnerships): I'll prep the three hero variants and drop the blurb in this thread by EOD. For the short marketing blurb draft: "Redwood Inference — predictable, low-latency LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Try a 14-day Starter trial." Thoughts?
Sam (legal): Edit: change "Try a 14-day Starter trial" to "Includes a 14-day Starter evaluation" and add: "By starting the evaluation you agree to the Redwood Inference EULA and telemetry policy." We'll attach the EULA PDF to the listing package.
Jordan (product): Noted. For SKU mapping, here's the proposed mapping for marketplace packaging (staging values):
```
SKU: RW-STARTER-TRIAL -> OfferCode: RW-MKT-START-2024 -> Visibility: public
SKU: RW-SCALE-EVAL -> OfferCode: RW-MKT-SCALE-2024 -> Visibility: public
SKU: RW-ENTERPRISE -> OfferCode: RW-MKT-EN-QUOTE -> Visibility: private
```
Leo (eng): I'll populate the actual OfferIDs once publisher portal provisioning is done. For now use placeholders in manifests. Also need publisher sandbox creds — @Alex can you request from marketplace ops?
Alex (partnerships): On it. Filing request ticket now and pinging ops. Ticket# OPS-7342. Will post creds here when available (will redact secrets).
publisher-bot: Publisher portal request created: OPS-7342. Status: pending approvals.
Mira (partnerships): One more thing — Azure requires customer-facing FAQ entries for support & SLA. Jordan, can you draft 3 FAQ bullets (onboarding, backups, SLAs) so I can include them in the asset bundle?
Jordan (product): Draft: 1) Onboarding: "Start with the Starter evaluation; provisioning takes ~20 min via marketplace." 2) Backups: "Customers on Dedicated get nightly KV-cache snapshots by default; private deployments configurable." 3) SLA: "Dedicated customers are eligible for 99.9% uptime SLAs; see enterprise plan for full terms." Copy-edit as needed.
Sam (legal): I'll review the FAQ copy for any regulated wording. Also send me the final asset zip before publication.
Leo (eng): Once ops gives sandbox creds I'll run a dry publish to staging and paste the publish log. Plan to run that tomorrow 10:00 PT.
Alex (partnerships): Thanks team — action items: Mira assets + blurb (EOD), Alex ticket + creds, Leo AMI + manifest + staging publish tomorrow, Jordan FAQ + confirm SKU mapping, Sam legal review + EULA attachment. I'll follow up in morning standup. :thumbsup:
